methodology: Risk scores reflect official FCCPC/Google Play regulatory action, not editorial opinion. Base score 8 = delisted for operating without FCCPC approval (2022 Digital Lending Framework). +1 for an additionally documented consumer-privacy violation. +1 for a 2026 DEON-non-compliance blacklisting. A collective complaint pattern (contact-list harassment, undisclosed fees, unauthorized deductions, defamatory recovery tactics) is attributed by FCCPC to the delisted-app category as a whole, not confirmed per individual app unless separately cited below.
coverage_note: This dataset is a curated sample, not the full FCCPC register. The commission has stated it blacklisted 45 apps in January 2026 and approved over 430 digital lenders, but has not published either as a single complete public list as of this update. If a search here comes back with no match, that is not a certification of safety — check the live register at fccpc.gov.ng/registration-of-digital-money-lenders before you borrow.
